sections.text_helper: Section 36.7.10 "LPTIM autoreload register (LPTIM_ARR)" in chapter 36 (Low-power timer (LPTIM)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1520.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x018
Reset value: 0x0000 0001
Bits 31:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 ARR[15:0]: Auto reload value
ARR is the autoreload value for the LPTIM.
This value must be strictly greater than the CCRx[15:0] value.
Caution: The LPTIM_ARR register must only be modified when the LPTIM is enabled (ENABLE bit
set to 1).
